bullets.text: AI-Powered Photo Organization - **Microsoft Photos** now features AI-driven auto-categorization for efficient photo management.
Windows 11 Insider Build Update - **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build 27954 introduces general improvements and fixes.
New Highlights API in Edge - **Microsoft Edge** 140 introduces highlightsFromPoint() for enhanced text editing capabilities.
Reimagined Microsoft Marketplace - **Microsoft Marketplace** unifies solutions, offering thousands of AI apps and cloud solutions.
XCSSET Malware Variant Update - **Microsoft** analyzes a new XCSSET variant targeting developers' Xcode projects.
Windows ML Now Available - **Windows ML** enables local AI deployment across Windows devices for developers.
AI-Enhanced Phishing Detection - **Microsoft** blocks an AI-obfuscated phishing campaign, showcasing advanced detection capabilities.
Microsoft Purview Success - **Microsoft Purview** achieves a 30% reduction in data breach likelihood for organizations.
